 Starting XI: Is This Regis Le Bris’s Line Up For Sunderland At Villa Park?
 Is it the most predictable line up of the season? Probably not!
 by Martin Wanless Nov 21, 2026, 6:00 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 SUNDERLAND, ENGLAND - NOVEMBER 8: Regis Le Bris, Manager of Sunderland portrait before the Premier League 2026/27 match between Sunderland and Chelsea FC at Stadium of Light on November 8, 2026 in Sunderland, England. (Photo by Richard Sellers/Sportsphoto/Allstar via Getty Images) Getty Images Our last game against Chelsea was a step in the right direction for Regis Le Bris and the team, and we need to show that wasn’t a one-off today. Comments from Le Bris saying that the Chelsea game provides the blueprint for us moving forward are right – and Villa will want to dominate the ball today, which is the sort of game we prefer to play. Our away record over the past 12 months is the worst in the Premier League though, so we need to do something differently and start picking up points on the road. This would be a great place to start. Team wise, we’re suffering badly from injuries – Ballard, Mundle, Diarra, Xhaka and Brobbey are all out, and there’s rumours too about Le Fee being injured too. Hopefully that’s not true, but regardless the players who come in have to seize the opportunity.
 Goalkeeper: Robin Roefs
 Roefs will be in goal – a clear sheet last time out will have done his confidence no harm at all.
 SUNDERLAND, ENGLAND - NOVEMBER 08: Sunderland goalscorer Enzo Le Fee celebrates with goalkeeper Robin Roefs after the Premier League 2026/27 match between Sunderland and Chelsea FC at Stadium of Light on November 08, 2026 in Sunderland, England. (Photo by Stu Forster/Getty Images) Getty Images Defence: Thomas Meunier, Nordi Mukiele, Luke O’Nien, Reinildo
 I think we’ll be unchanged at the back today – while Omar Alderete is available again, and Kevin Danso available too, the reality is that Mukiele and O’Nien are our strongest centreback pairing at present, while the experience of Meunier and Reinildo will get the nod at full back too.
 SUNDERLAND, ENGLAND - NOVEMBER 8: Sunderland’s Nordi Mukiele reacts after he fouls Chelsea’s Morgan Rogers during the Premier League 2026/27 match between Sunderland and Chelsea FC at Stadium of Light on November 8, 2026 in Sunderland, United Kingdom. (Photo by Lee Parker - CameraSport via Getty Images) CameraSport via Getty Images Midfield: Trai Hume, Noah Sadiki, Jules Ahoka, Enzo Le Fee, Chemsdine Talbi
 Trai Hume will likely keep his place on the right of midfield, while Chemsdine Talbi’s strong display against Chelsea should see him keep his place in the team. Jules Ahoka’s got to come in for Xhaka, while Sadiki will play in the centre alongside him – hopefully with Le Fee. If Enzo’s out I think Le Bris will pick Rigg – personally, I’d go with Talbi in the 10 and either Fofana or Angulo wide left. Alan Browne could be a wildcard selection…
 SUNDERLAND, ENGLAND - NOVEMBER 8: Sunderland’s Jules Ahoka applauds the fans at the end of the match during the Premier League 2026/27 match between Sunderland and Chelsea FC at Stadium of Light on November 8, 2026 in Sunderland, United Kingdom. (Photo by Lee Parker - CameraSport via Getty Images) CameraSport via Getty Images Striker: Wilson Isidor
 With Brobbey seemingly out, Wilson Isidor will most likely play up front – if he does we’ve got to get players closer to him in the build up. He’s not an out and out replacement for Brobbey – who is? – so we can’t expect him to slot in and do what Brobbey does. We need to get him playing over the top and stretching the Villa defence, which will require a more progressive midfield game.
 SUNDERLAND, ENGLAND - NOVEMBER 8: Mike Penders, goalkeeper of Chelsea saves shot from Wilson Isidor of Sunderland during the Premier League 2026/27 match between Sunderland and Chelsea FC at Stadium of Light on November 8, 2026 in Sunderland, England.
